import pathlib,json,socket,subprocess,time,urllib.request,signal,tarfile,gzip
root=pathlib.Path('/tmp/wukongim-migration-original-three-four-slots');root.mkdir(exist_ok=False)
ids=[1,2,3];nodes=[];reserved=[];processes=[];logs=[]
for nid in ids:
 ports=[]
 for _ in range(4):
  s=socket.socket();s.bind(('127.0.0.1',0));ports.append(s.getsockname()[1]);reserved.append(s)
 nodes.append({'id':nid,'tcp':ports[0],'api':ports[1],'ws':ports[2],'cluster':ports[3]})
(root/'nodes.json').write_text(json.dumps(nodes,indent=2))
try:
 for n in nodes:
  d=root/str(n['id']);d.mkdir()
  init='\n'.join(f'    - {m["id"]}@127.0.0.1:{m["cluster"]}' for m in nodes)
  config=f'''mode: debug
rootDir: {d}
dataDir: {d}/data
addr: tcp://127.0.0.1:{n['tcp']}
httpAddr: 127.0.0.1:{n['api']}
wsAddr: ws://127.0.0.1:{n['ws']}
manager:
  on: false
demo:
  on: false
logger:
  level: 2
  dir: {d}/logs
auth:
  kind: none
plugin:
  socketPath: {d}/plugin.sock
cluster:
  nodeId: {n['id']}
  addr: tcp://127.0.0.1:{n['cluster']}
  serverAddr: 127.0.0.1:{n['cluster']}
  apiUrl: http://127.0.0.1:{n['api']}
  slotCount: 4
  slotReplicaCount: 3
  channelReplicaCount: 3
  initNodes:
{init}
db:
  shardNum: 2
'''
  (d/'source.yaml').write_text(config)
 for s in reserved:s.close()
 for n in nodes:
  d=root/str(n['id']);log=(d/'process.log').open('wb');logs.append(log)
  processes.append(subprocess.Popen(['/tmp/wukongim-v2-original-a888f895','--config',str(d/'source.yaml')],stdout=log,stderr=subprocess.STDOUT))
 print('Started original v2 nodes',ids,flush=True)
 deadline=time.monotonic()+55
 while time.monotonic()<deadline:
  if any(p.poll() is not None for p in processes):raise RuntimeError('source exited during startup')
  if all('server started successfully' in (root/str(n['id'])/'process.log').read_text() for n in nodes):break
  time.sleep(.2)
 else:raise TimeoutError('source readiness timeout')
 print('All original v2 nodes ready',flush=True)
 trace=[]
 def call(path,data=None,n=nodes[0]):
  req=urllib.request.Request(f'http://127.0.0.1:{n["api"]}'+path,data=None if data is None else json.dumps(data).encode(),headers={'Content-Type':'application/json'})
  with urllib.request.urlopen(req,timeout=15) as r:result=json.load(r)
  trace.append({'node_id':n['id'],'path':path,'request':data,'response':result});(root/'api-baseline.json').write_text(json.dumps(trace,indent=2));return result
 deadline=time.monotonic()+25
 while time.monotonic()<deadline:
  configs=[json.loads((root/str(n['id'])/'data/cluster/config/remote.json').read_text()) for n in nodes]
  if len(set(json.dumps(c,sort_keys=True) for c in configs))==1 and all(n.get('apiServerAddr') for n in configs[0]['nodes']):break
  time.sleep(.2)
 else:raise TimeoutError('original configuration routes did not converge')
 for uid in ['migrationalice','migrationbob']:
  assert call('/user/token',{'uid':uid,'token':'synthetic-'+uid,'device_flag':1,'device_level':1})['status']==200
 assert call('/channel',{'channel_id':'migrationgroup','channel_type':2,'subscribers':['migrationalice','migrationbob']})['status']==200
 for i in range(3):assert call('/message/send',{'header':{'red_dot':1},'from_uid':'migrationalice','channel_id':'migrationgroup','channel_type':2,'client_msg_no':'multi-source-'+str(i),'payload':'aGVsbG8='})['status']==200
 for n in nodes:call('/channel/messagesync',{'login_uid':'migrationbob','channel_id':'migrationgroup','channel_type':2,'limit':100},n)
 deadline=time.monotonic()+30
 while time.monotonic()<deadline:
  all_slots=[]
  good=True
  for slot in range(4):
   reports=[call(f'/cluster/slots/{slot}/localReplica',n=n) for n in nodes]
   expected=reports[0]['last_log_seq']
   if not all(r['applied_index']==r['committed_index']==r['last_log_seq']==expected for r in reports):good=False
   all_slots.append(reports)
  if good:break
  time.sleep(.2)
 else:raise TimeoutError('source Slots did not converge')
 (root/'slot-api-baseline.json').write_text(json.dumps(all_slots,indent=2))
 print('Original v2 data and Slot API baseline captured',flush=True)
finally:
 for p in processes:
  if p.poll() is None:p.send_signal(signal.SIGINT)
 for p in processes:
  try:p.wait(timeout=15)
  except subprocess.TimeoutExpired:p.kill();p.wait();print('source required forced termination',flush=True)
 for f in logs:f.close()
print('Original v2 source stopped',flush=True)
for n in nodes:
 d=root/str(n['id'])/'data'
 with open(root/f'node-{n["id"]}.tar.gz','wb') as raw:
  with gzip.GzipFile(fileobj=raw,mode='wb',mtime=0) as gz:
   with tarfile.open(fileobj=gz,mode='w') as tar:
    for p in sorted(d.rglob('*')):
     info=tar.gettarinfo(str(p),arcname=str(p.relative_to(d)));info.uid=info.gid=0;info.uname=info.gname='';info.mtime=0
     if p.is_file():
      with p.open('rb') as f:tar.addfile(info,f)
     else:tar.addfile(info)
print('Saved stopped fixtures under',root,flush=True)
